text:
Sasha: quick idea — small deploy-bot/CLI improvements to reduce churn during rollouts and make release notes + change-windows first-class.
Sasha: proposal: add a --safety-sweeper flag that runs a lightweight preflight checklist (change-window sanity, release notes link present, pinned-version consistency). and a `deploy-template init` generator that outputs a small checklist + release-note md skeleton.
Sasha: example usage:
Sasha: ```
/deploy service/api --version v2.3.1 --change-window '2026-03-22 02:00-03:00' --safety-sweeper --release-link https://our-releases/redwood/v2.3.1
```
Tim: sounds useful. what does safety-sweeper do on failure? auto-block? auto-revert?
Sasha: by default it should block the deploy and surface a clear error with remediation links. opt-in behavior could be auto-revert with a short grace period and oncall confirmation.
Morgan: for the template generator: i suggest it emits two artifacts: releases/v2.3.1.md and deployments/service-api-checklist.yaml. YAML has gates: healthcheck, traffic-shift (%), postdeploy smoke tests.
Aisha: must have force overrides for emergencies. oncall needs to be pinged when force is used and PR deploys that skip checks should be audited.
Sasha: planned flags: --force (bypass sweeper), --sweeper-mode={warn,block,auto-revert}, and deploy-bot will DM oncall on --force with a link to the deploy + who forced it.
Tim: does this conflict with change-window enforcement we already have in infra? we only need to lint the window format and warn if outside policy.
Morgan: no conflict — sweeper should validate format + cross-check policy service. if outside allowed window, default to block unless --force.
Aisha: also add a brief rollback playbook link in the fail message. many people open PRs then scramble when something fails.
Sasha: yes — template will include rollback steps and quick commands, e.g.:
Sasha: ```
# quick rollback
/deploy service/api --version v2.3.0 --change-window 'now' --reason "rollback regressed latency"
```
deploy-bot: preflight queued: validating change-window -> OK; checking release-link -> MISSING; pinned-version mismatch -> WARNING
Tim: deploy-bot output is perfect. can we include suggested fixes inline? e.g., "add --release-link or run `deploy-template init`"
Morgan: i can prototype CLI arg parsing + template generator. plan: add a command `deploy-template init --service service/api --version v2.3.1` that spits out both md + yaml and a one-liner to run the deploy with sweeper.
Aisha: telemetry note: tag deploys with sweeper_mode and rollback_reason to help postmortems.
Sasha: i'll draft a one-page spec and link it here when ready. i'll also add a tiny example PR diff to the deploy-bot repo.
Morgan: i'll open the PR and include unit tests for flag parsing + a smoke test that runs the template generator. ETA: EOD Thurs.
Tim: great. @Morgan @Sasha when PR lands i'll coordinate a canary rollout (small backend service first) and keep window narrow.
Aisha: please add a config flag so orgs can opt-out of auto-revert behavior (some teams don't want that by default).
Sasha: noted. thanks all :thumbsup!
Tim: +1 — let's sync after PR.
